notes: Boot harl_a40 with built-in mechanisms disabled (--handle-mechanics 0), four balls on trough switches 11-14, and both motorcycle position switches open (35 and 36 at public 0). Wait for the ROM to energize the motor relay (solenoid 19), raise the Motor Down switch 36 to 1 two seconds later and observe whether the relay drops, then observe for 40 s more.
